about: One record per material id. art/data/material_catalog.json, game/data/material_catalog.json and art/textures/catalog_mapping.json are generated from this file by art/tools/material_registry.py --write. Cast Lily/Stacy materials use asset-owned glTF PBR maps in game/assets/characters/lily and game/assets/characters/stacy; source_set null and texture_status no_maps refer only to the absence of central canonical T_* texture sets, not to those imported maps.

legacy_order.about: Key order of catalog_mapping.json, kept only so the generated file stays byte-identical while fixtures pin it. Removed at the renewal pass.
